stem: The Savannas are most widespread in –
expl: Savanna is a rolling grassland scattered with shrubs and isolated trees which can be found between a tropical rainforest and desert biome. The savannas are mainly spread, over East Africa. Savannas are also found in Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela, Belize, Honduras and the southern parts of India. Therefore, the correct answer is option (a).

stem: What is the name of mid-latitude grassland in South America?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Mid-latitudes or temperate belt grasslands of South America are known as Pampas. They are spread over Argentina, Uruguay and southern parts of Brazil. Other mid-latitude grasslands are Prairie (North America), Downs (Australia), etc.

Code :

expl: The Pampas of South America are a grassland biome. They are flat, fertile plains, found primarily in Argentina and extend into Uruguay and Brazil. Because of the temperate climate and rich, deep soil, most of the Pampas have been brought under cultivation and turned into croplands.

stem: The wide treeless grassy plain in South America are called
expl: Pampas are the grasslands of South America. These plains are very fertile. These grass fields spread from the Atlantic Ocean to the Andes Mountains up to Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay.

stem: Which one of the following natural regions is known as 'Land of Big Games'?
expl: Land of Big Games is known as the Tropical Savanna region, as thousands of animals are trapped or killed each year by people from all over the world. There are two main groups of animals in the savanna, the grass-eating herbivorous animals and the flesh-eating carnivorous animals. The herbivorous include the zebra, antelope, giraffe, deer, gazelle, elephant etc. and carnivorous animals include the lion, tiger, jackal, jaguar, leopard, hyena etc. Species of reptiles and mammals include giant lizards, crocodiles, alligators that live together with larger rhinoceroses and hippopotamuses in rivers and marshy lakes.

stem:
The vegetation of savannah consists of grassland with scattered small trees, but extensive areas have no trees. The forest development in such areas is generally kept in check by one or more or a combination of some conditions. Which of the following are such conditions?
1. Burrowing animals and termites
2. Fire
3. Grazing herbivores
4. Seasonal rainfall
5. Soil properties
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
expl: The main obstacle in the development of forest in the savanna grassland is the abundance of grass-grazing animals, fire in this area and seasonal rainfall. Due to seasonal rains, everything dries up in the summer in this region, due to which the development of forest is not possible in this area.
